text.p: These are the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat agree to a meeting of the two sides' joint committee after the Moslem Eid al-Fitr feast.
- A ministerial reshuffle possible in the next month that could include eight or nine cabinet posts and Islamists deny being consulted, sources.
- Relatives of Jordanian prisoners in Kuwait say that detainees beaten in their prison cells by Kuwaiti special forces.
- King and Arafat discuss latest developments in the peace process and Jordan affirms "its support of Palestinians to enable them to attain their rights on their national soil".
- King Fahd congratulates king on his recuperation from minor operation.
- Editor in chief of a tabloid arrested at home.
